jobs.prompt:
OWNER TEST RESULTS for the Build progress view (tools/build-progress.mjs, rendered by tools/watch-assets/project.js and the card line in tools/watch-assets/board.js; data from tools/board-data.mjs). Fix all seven. Read-only toward projects; do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, package.json, CHANGELOG.md or README.md.

1) Main % = tickets done / tickets total, where total excludes cancelled, proposed and human tickets (human tickets are the owner checklist per roadmap R-015). percent.overall becomes this ticket %; requirements % stays as a secondary field (percent.requirements) and the UI shows it second ('42% · requirements 30%').
2) Requirement coverage: normalize every ticket's requirement links by extracting all /R-\d{3,}/ ids from scopeRefs entries (strings may be 'R-001', 'R-001 text', lowercase 'r-001' -> uppercase), and also from ticket.requirement / ticket.requirements if present. A requirement is covered when it has at least one non-human, non-cancelled, non-proposed ticket and all of those are done.
3) Milestones per scope, not repo-wide: PR open / Merged count only history pr/merge events that are linked to THIS scope: (a) event.run is the id of a run whose state jobs include a job whose id or ticket field equals a ledger ticket id, or whose state.ticketIds/state.tickets list includes one; or (b) event.ref (#N) equals a ledger ticket's pr field (number or '#N' or URL ending /pull/N); and in both cases event.at >= ledger.approved.at when approved. Current step = the LATEST milestone reached (the furthest 'done' one in order) is marked state 'current' (with done styling plus emphasis in the UI); everything after it is 'todo'; when nothing is done the first is current. Deployed keeps its own rules (unknown stays unknown and never becomes current).
4) Stage mapping bug: on project-swarm all 37 done tickets show under the last stage 'Managers, first versions'. Fix the ticket -> stage mapping: build requirementStage from the scope (requirement id -> stage id); a ticket's effective stage = its own stage when it is a scope stage id AND agrees with the stage of its requirement links; else the earliest stage among its linked requirements; else its own stage string; else 'none'. Count stage rows by effective stage. Add a test reproducing the reported symptom (tickets carrying a wrong/last stage but scopeRefs in earlier stages land in their requirements' stages).
5) ETA null: when tickets.log has fewer than 2 done times, fall back to other completion evidence: run state jobs whose id or ticket equals a done ticket id (use job.finishedAt), then linked merge history events (rule 3) mapped to their tickets; dedupe per ticket, keep the earliest evidence; then apply the existing 14/30/all-time widening; basis says the source ('from run finish times' when the fallback was used). Also guard perDay: if it rounds to 0, compute days from the unrounded rate and never return Infinity/NaN (cap days at 3650).
   'Stale (48 s)': the project page goes stale. In tools/watch-assets/project.js wrap each panel renderer (spend, progress, split, bench, handled, tickets, runs, lessons) in its own try/catch so one throwing panel never aborts render() (show 'This panel failed to render.' in that panel and console.error once); make sure the page's live/stale chip is updated on every successful /api/project or /api/live response even if a panel throws (find how the chip and LIVE_MS/liveness work in tools/watch-assets/board-lib.js and tools/watch-assets/project-live.js and fix the path that leaves it stale). Explain the root cause in your final notes.
6) Stage display names, not raw ids: every place that shows a stage (progress stage rows, the card's 'stage S1' tag via ticketsOf in board-data, left.human items) shows the scope title (e.g. 'Managers, first versions'); ids not in the scope show 'Stage N' for S<N> (e.g. 'S0' -> 'Stage 0') and 'No stage' for none. Keep the raw id in a separate field (stageId) for tests.
7) Off-ledger work: runs in the project's .swarm/runs (both the card root and the chosen ledger root) started in the last 14 days whose jobs map to no ledger ticket id are 'off-ledger work'. buildProgress returns offLedger: { runs: [{ runId, startedAt, status, jobs, done, costUsd, prs: ['#N' from history events whose run equals runId] }], count }. The project page shows an 'Off-ledger work' block (runs newest first with their PRs) and the card line adds ' · N off-ledger runs' when N > 0.
Tests: extend tests/build-progress-roadmap.test.mjs (real docs/scope/roadmap.md as the scope fixture; the owner will add the real ledgers later) with: main % excludes cancelled/proposed/human; coverage with messy scopeRefs ('r-007 tickets sized'); a scope's PR milestone ignores a repo PR not linked to its tickets and counts a linked one only after approval; current = latest reached; the stage-mapping repro (wrong last stage -> requirement stage), display names incl. 'Stage 0'; ETA from run finish times when tickets.log is empty, and the perDay-rounds-to-0 guard; off-ledger runs listed with their PR refs. Keep tests/build-progress.test.mjs and tests/board-page.test.mjs green (update expectations only where these rules change them). Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/build-progress-roadmap.test.mjs tests/build-progress.test.mjs tests/board-page.test.mjs tests/board-worktrees.test.mjs tests/board-nav.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. Tests in ignoreTests use these files for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the full suite after integration.
